onlineGala.focus: Africa Education Icons of the Decade
onlineGala.summary: The NESA-Africa 2026 Online Recognition Programme will take place on Sunday, 13 December 2026. The programme will involve approximately 20–30 invited live participants and will principally recognise up to nine Africa Education Icons.
onlineGala.selectionIntro: Up to nine Africa Education Icons of the Decade may be selected. Every nominee must provide a 10-year documented activity profile for evaluation against these eight weighted criteria.
onlineGala.selectionNote: Independent verification, jury review and authorised governance confirmation are required. A nomination or score does not guarantee selection. Public voting, sponsorship and donations do not influence selection.
categories: Literary and New Curriculum Advocate Icon
onlineGala.production: The programme will involve approximately 20–30 invited live participants. No public physical gala, ticket sale, corporate table or public venue is currently authorised.
onlineGala.presentation: Icon documentaries · Approved interviews · Education-impact stories · Regional contributions · International contributions · Certificates of Recognition · NESA-Africa TV coverage · Africa Education Enablers Podcast features.
onlineGala.continuation: Tier 2–4 nominations, verification and documentary recognition continue through 31 March 2027. Keeping the portal open does not guarantee recognition.
onlineGala.integrity: Recognition cannot be bought. Sponsorship, donations, partnerships, endorsements and media participation do not influence eligibility, scoring or recognition decisions.
onlineGala.nominationNotice: Submitting a nomination begins a review process. It does not confirm identity verification, eligibility, shortlisting, judging, recognition or certificate entitlement.
onlineGala.broadcast: The broadcast will be carried on authorised platforms.
onlineGala.broadcastPending: SCEF has not supplied the final viewing links. No unofficial stream or attendance link is published.
onlineGala.ticketAnswer: No. There are no ticket sales or physical attendance.
onlineGala.voteQuestion: Can I vote before the event?
onlineGala.voteAnswer: No. NESA-Africa 2026 has no public voting.
onlineGala.restrictions: No public physical gala, ticket sale, corporate table or public venue is currently authorised.

schoolSupport.fund: Africa Special Needs Education Support Fund
schoolSupport.heading: Support a Special-Needs School Across Africa
schoolSupport.intro: Help identify, verify and support specialist schools and inclusive mainstream schools serving learners with disabilities and additional support needs.
schoolSupport.delivery: The Africa Special Needs Education Support Fund is delivered jointly by NESA-Africa and EduAid-Africa under Santos Creations Educational Foundation. Fundraising and supporter mobilisation are coordinated through Friends of EduAid-Africa and the Africa Education Enablers Network.
schoolSupport.nominate: Nominate a Special-Needs School in Africa
schoolSupport.support: Support a Special-Needs School in Africa
schoolSupport.notice: Nomination begins a verification and needs-assessment process. It does not automatically qualify a school for publication, voting, funding or intervention.
schoolSupport.independence: Regional school selection is separate from NESA-Africa award recognition. Donations, sponsorship and regional participation do not affect NESA-Africa judging or recognition decisions.
schoolSupport.approvalPending: School profiles will appear only after verification and explicit publication approval are confirmed.
schoolSupport.channelsRequired: CONTENT REQUIRED — authorised EduAid-Africa school-support links and publication approvals.
